2124956446836056400.en_summary: When one man becomes too important to fail, the entire financial system has a problem. Jensen Huang's reinstatement revealed how dependent markets and confidence have become on NVIDIA and the AI investment cycle. Board initially rejected then reversed after intervention. NVIDIA lost over 1.2 trillion market cap, rally on return more bearish than bullish as it shows sensitivity to one individual. Administration managing timing of adjustment. Huang's return removed one catalyst but did not resolve underlying vulnerabilities.
2124956446836056400.zh_summary: 當一個人變得太重要而不能失敗時，整個金融系統就有問題。Jensen Huang 的復職揭示了市場和信心對 NVIDIA 和 AI 投資週期的依賴程度。董事會最初拒絕，然後在干預後逆轉。NVIDIA 損失超過 1.2 萬億市值，回歸後的反彈比看漲更看淡，因為它顯示對一個人的敏感性。政府管理調整時機。Huang 的回歸移除了一個催化劑，但沒有解決潛在脆弱性。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 市場對單一個人過度依賴，回歸反彈顯示系統脆弱
